description: Ministry of Industry & Commerce - Authorize the purpose for Civil Society Organization Interactive Resources Centre for Local Empowerment Society Limited as a purpose to the Powers & facilities of the Societies Ordinance to be extended
reasoning: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize the purpose of a specific civil society organization. It involves regulatory action under existing legislation (the Societies Ordinance) rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. This falls squarely within Legal/Regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
